sourceNote: The Tripo P2 polar bear mesh with its quads (assets/models/polar-bear/README.md) and its color map. The hand rig of tripo-hand/polar-bear.blend starts from it.
name: Polar bear
jointsNote: The places are in the body units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the skull top, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX file has no armature, so each joint comes from cuts of the mesh and from its edge loops: the trunk joints on the middle line of the trunk sections, the shoulder joint inside the arm root, the elbow at the arm loop at x 0.257 (0.52 of the arm from the shoulder to the wrist, as the upper arm and forearm of the main polar bear), the wrist at x 0.372 where the paw widens, the knuckles at x 0.44 where the toes part, the hip joint in the haunch, the knee at the leg loop at y 0.164, and the ankle above the heel.
palmNote: The paws of the source lie flat with the claws curled down, so the palm faces down.

bind.note: The thighs slope 20 degrees down and 12 degrees out, and each shin slants 5 degrees forward of the vertical, and the feet stand flat (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 20 12 5). The bind arms are those of the main polar bear. The bind paw of each arm turns about its bind forearm toward supination by bindSupination degrees (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py).

colors.note: Each face takes the mean sRGB color of the color map at a grid of samples (add_surface()). The eye box holds the eyeballs (middles at x 0.034, y 0.924, z 0.095), and the nose box the black nose tip.

tone.note: No move. The hand route does not read the tone. The color map of the source replaces the face colors in the app.

eyeShell.note: The values of the other meshes. The hand rig adds no eye fans (eye_fans=False).

chair.note: The piano bench of the pianist, as on the main polar bear (benchFitOf() of tools/body-module.ts).

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone of this length in units.

rollSplitNote: The simple route splits the roll segments by place (roll_split() of tools/blender/simple_rig.py). The hand rig sets the same split in the exact rows of each arm ring (assets/models/polar-bear/README.md, "tripo-hand/polar-bear.blend").
